full_judgment: 9. Mr Miah then submits that in a case of death of the wife in husband's house, a heavy onus lies upon the husband to account for the death. The husband is duty bound to explain how his wife met with her death. In the absence of any reasonable explanation coming from husband's side, the irresistible presumption is that it is he, who is responsible for her death. In this case the husband did not explain specifically the cause of death of the victim, which definitely points the finger at him.
